title: Nawat Itsaragrisil proud of Thai Miss Asia Pacific International 2026 winner

blocks.text: CEBU CITY — Miss Grand International Pres. Nawat Itsaragrisil is very proud of newly-crowned Miss Asia Pacific International Sasiwararin Atsawahirankarn and is planning a grand welcome for her when she returns home to Thailand. The Thai beauty revealed this at the post-coronation press conference held at Marco Polo Cebu in Cebu City on Sunday afternoon, Oct. 11, just a day after the Grand Coronation Night held at Mactan Expo on Oct. 10. Sasiwararin said she spoke with the Thai pageant organizer after she won the crown.
